newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Around 67 new industrial projects involving a total investment of 1.37 billion riyals will be implemented in Saudi Arabia's Asir province.
- Some 16 medical clinics closed down in Jeddah for repeated violations of health regulations.
- Philippine Airlines is seeking fifth freedom rights on Jeddah-Dubai route.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed plans to invest more in Palestinian-held areas.
- King Fahd receives a letter from Yemen's president.
- Trade between Saudi Arabia and Egypt stood at $550 million in 1996.
- King Fahd Mosque to open in Gibraltar at a cost of 30 million riyals.
